description: Looks up a Solana token by mint address and returns a safety report built from third-party on-chain analysis: a 0 to 100 risk score (0 is lowest risk) with a risk level, whether the token shows honeypot or rug signals, whether liquidity is locked, whether the mint and freeze authorities are still active, top-holder concentration, total liquidity in USD and a list of warnings. Read-only and informational; not financial advice.

mint.description: Solana token mint address in base58, 32 to 44 characters.

name: check_token_safety
title: Check Solana token safety
